peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 4.3% above its local comparables; 39 of 54 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (83.5): 4.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 75 of 91 similar developments with a figure (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 100% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 1993.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,296,500 ($1,359 psf, 925–1,011 sq ft; 32 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,296 psf (range $1,200–1,403); 4.9% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $60,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,700,000 ($1,414 psf, 1,184–1,345 sq ft; 16 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,364 psf (range $1,193–1,999); 3.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $60,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Bayshore MRT about 160 m, Siglap MRT about 930 m; closer than 77 of 94 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Temasek Primary School about 900 m; more than 19 of 94 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 1 supermarket within 1 km (nearest about 290 m), more than 6 of 94 similar developments (the same as 15); nearest hawker centre East Coast Lagoon Food Village about 780 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area F about 310 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Vela Bay, 386 new sales, about 260 m; Sceneca Residence, 3 new sales, about 1,850 m; Bagnall Haus, 11 new sales, about 1,920 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 77 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 400 new sales and 545 resales (945 purchases); new sales were 42.3% of these purchases. Subsales (23) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bedok Rise GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,720 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 545 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 64 of 94 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 545 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 586 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−7%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
